name: Anime archetypes
description: The hero, the rival, the mentor and everyone else.

cards.name: The Hero Who Never Gives Up
cards.rule_text:
Haste
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature you control that's attacking.
When CARDNAME dies, return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Eternal Rival
cards.rule_text:
Menace
Whenever a creature an opponent controls with greater power than CARDNAME dies, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.

cards.name: Wise Old Mentor
cards.rule_text:
When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
When CARDNAME dies, draw a card.

cards.name: Comic Relief Sidekick
cards.rule_text: Whenever another creature you control dies, you gain 2 life and scry 1.

cards.name: Childhood Friend
cards.rule_text:
When CARDNAME enters, target legendary creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.
{1}{W}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target creature you control to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Mysterious Mascot
cards.rule_text:
Flying
CARDNAME can't block.
Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, draw a card.

cards.name: The Villain's Grand Plan
cards.rule_text:
At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses 1 life for each creature card in your graveyard.
When a legendary creature you control dies, draw two cards.

cards.name: Unrivaled Genius
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, look at the top five cards of your library. Put two of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

cards.name: Gentle Giant
cards.rule_text:
Reach
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to other creatures you control by sources your opponents control.

cards.name: Cold-Eyed Assassin
cards.rule_text:
Flash
Deathtouch
When CARDNAME enters, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

cards.name: Hot-Blooded Delinquent
cards.rule_text:
Haste
CARDNAME attacks each combat if able.
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, it deals 1 damage to defending player.

cards.name: Mysterious Masked Ally
cards.rule_text:
Ninjutsu {1}{U}
Whenever CARDNAME deals combat damage to a player, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.

cards.name: Ancient Sealed Evil
cards.rule_text:
Flying, trample
CARDNAME enters with four oblivion counters on it. It can't attack or block while it has an oblivion counter on it.
At the beginning of your upkeep, remove an oblivion counter from CARDNAME.

cards.name: Power Unleashed
cards.rule_text: Target creature you control gets +X/+0 and gains trample until end of turn. If X is 5 or more, untap it.
